summary: Tested the new reactive POS↔Gateway/Link de Pago behaviour in /direct-projects (DirectProjectCreation.jsx). All 5 acceptance criteria PASS end-to-end (UI reactivity, integrator filter, persistence of digital matrix). Created a real Gateway project, validated implementation_matrix/services/banks via API GET, then deleted it. No backend regression detected; no VPOS/MPOS regression.

issues: Console hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>/<tr>' triggered by external instrumentation wrappers (data-ve-dynamic=true display:contents) injected by the preview tooling around <tr>/<th>/<tbody>. Pre-existing, NOT caused by this iteration's change. Not user-visible, but adds noise to console.

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean: PG_LIKE/INTEGRATOR_MODALITY_MATCH helpers are centralised at the top of the file (lines 30-38); certifiedIntegrators memo (l.429) correctly intersects status==='Certificado' with the modality predicate; quote_type onValueChange (l.798) resets boxes_grid + integrator + forces project_type='simple'/cantidad_cajas=1 in PG mode. No dead code.
File DirectProjectCreation.jsx is 1529 lines (>700). Consider splitting the Reel/Matrix card and the Multi-RIF/Multistore cards into sub-components for maintainability — non-blocking.

cantidad_cajas is forced to 1 for Gateway/Link in the FE and the backend Pydantic Field(ge=1) accepts it. OK. The persisted document still has boxes_grid with quantity=1 entries (additional services); harmless but worth documenting that for PG the 'quantity' field is semantically meaningless.
seed_data_creation: Created project PRY-2026-06-045-PRI (Cliente ABASTISIMO C.A, quote_type=GATEWAY, bank=100% Banco, product=Tarjeta de Crédito/Débito (PG)) and DELETED it at the end (HTTP 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token in this app is stored at localStorage.session_token (NOT 'token'). Use it for direct API smoke tests. project list/detail/delete live under /api/projects/{project_id} — /api/direct-projects only exposes POST. Login flow: /login → input[type=email], input[type=password], button 'Ingresar' → redirected to /dashboard. A red toast 'Atención! pulse ENTER' may appear; press Enter to dismiss before interacting with header chips.
